feature: Add Mobile Navigation Menu to Landing Page
workflow_rationale: Single-file UI enhancement with no backend changes, no database modifications, and no multi-service coordination. This is a straightforward frontend change following existing patterns from the dashboard components.

phases.name: Mobile Navigation Implementation
phases.description: Add hamburger menu button and mobile navigation drawer to the landing page Navigation component

subtasks.description: Convert Navigation to client component and add mobile menu state
implementation_notes: Add 'use client' directive at top of Navigation component
Follow pattern from components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx for state management
subtasks.notes: Successfully converted Navigation to client component. Split page.tsx into server component (with metadata) and page-client.tsx (with 'use client' directive). Added useState hook for mobile menu state management. Updated Navigation component to accept onMenuClick prop and added hamburger menu button following dashboard/header.tsx pattern.

subtasks.description: Add hamburger menu button for mobile

checks: Hamburger button visible on mobile (screen width < 768px)
Hamburger button hidden on desktop (screen width >= 768px)

implementation_notes: Replace existing mobile 'Başla' button with hamburger icon button
Use inline SVG from header.tsx: <path d='M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16' />
Add className: 'md:hidden rounded-lg p-2 text-secondary-600 hover:bg-secondary-100'
subtasks.notes: Hamburger menu button was already implemented in subtask-1-1. Verified implementation in app/page-client.tsx (lines 363-375): button uses md:hidden for mobile visibility, correct SVG icon from header.tsx pattern, proper hover states (hover:bg-secondary-100 dark:hover:bg-secondary-700), connected to onMenuClick prop, and includes aria-label="Menuyu ac" for accessibility. All requirements met.

subtasks.description: Create mobile menu drawer with backdrop

checks: Menu slides in from right side
All navigation links are visible and clickable

implementation_notes: Add backdrop overlay: {isMobileMenuOpen && <div className='fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/50' onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)} />}
Add mobile menu drawer: <div className={`fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-64 bg-white transform transition-transform ${isMobileMenuOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'}`}>
Include close button with X icon at top
List all navigation items: Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap, Ücretsiz Dene
Style links consistently with hover states
Add onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)} to each link to close menu after navigation
subtasks.notes: Successfully implemented mobile menu drawer with backdrop. Added slide-in animation from right side following sidebar.tsx pattern. Includes backdrop overlay with click-to-close, close (X) button in header, all navigation links (Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap, Ücretsiz Dene) with hover states, auto-close on link clicks, smooth transitions (duration-200 ease-in-out), and full dark mode support. Implementation matches pattern from components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx using z-index layering (backdrop z-40, drawer z-50), transform translations, and proper accessibility attributes.

subtasks.description: Keep register CTA visible on desktop navigation

checks: Desktop navigation shows all links (hidden md:flex works)
Register CTA button styled prominently on desktop
Responsive behavior correct at all breakpoints

implementation_notes: Ensure existing desktop nav (lines 354-370) remains unchanged
Desktop nav should keep hidden md:flex pattern
Mobile menu is additive - doesn't replace desktop nav
subtasks.notes: Verification task completed. All requirements already met from previous subtasks. Desktop navigation (lines 344-361) correctly uses 'hidden md:flex' pattern, showing all links including prominently styled Register CTA on desktop (≥768px). Mobile (< 768px) correctly shows only hamburger button with md:hidden. Responsive behavior verified at all breakpoints. No code changes needed - implementation is correct.

acceptance_criteria: Mobile users can access all navigation links via hamburger menu

verification_steps.name: Browser Verification - Mobile
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Hamburger menu opens/closes, all links work, smooth animations

verification_steps.name: Browser Verification - Desktop
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Desktop navigation unchanged, hamburger hidden on large screens

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI-only change with no backend logic, no data persistence, and following established patterns. Manual browser testing is sufficient.
